aboutPage.title: Automation with a Human Touch
aboutPage.subtitle: We're not a tech company that talks about tech. We're local people helping local businesses work better.
aboutPage.missionTitle: Why we do what we do
aboutPage.beliefText: A local business deserves the same tools as a multinational. The difference is we make them accessible, simple, and custom.
aboutPage.focusText: We don't sell technology. We sell hours you recover, clients you don't lose, and money you save. Technology is just the tool.
aboutPage.promiseText: If we don't save you time in the first month, you don't pay. Simple as that. We want results, not eternal contracts.
aboutPage.methodSubtitle: No jargon. No complications. No fine print.
aboutPage.step1Text: Tell us about your day-to-day. What wastes your time? Where do you lose clients? What repetitive tasks eat your hours? We ask and take notes.
aboutPage.step2Text: In 48h we present a concrete solution: what we'll automate, how it'll work, what you'll notice and what your clients will notice. No surprises.
aboutPage.step3Text: We install it, test it together and train you so you understand it. We stay by your side to adjust whatever's needed. You don't touch anything technical.
aboutPage.value1Text: Fixed price, no hidden costs. You know what you pay and what you get before starting.
aboutPage.value2Text: You'll see results from the first month. Not 6-month projects where nothing happens until the end.
aboutPage.value3Text: Zero jargon. We explain everything in plain language. If you don't understand, it's our fault.
aboutPage.value4Text: Based in Almenar, Lleida. We understand local businesses because we're part of them.
aboutPage.ctaText: Free first consultation with no commitment. Tell us about your business and we'll see how we can help.

contactPage.title: Let's Talk About Your Business
contactPage.subtitle: Free first consultation with no commitment. We listen, understand your business, and propose concrete solutions.
contactPage.faq1a: Yes, 100%. We talk about your business, identify opportunities and propose solutions. No pressure or commitment.
contactPage.faq2q: How long does a response take?
contactPage.faq2a: We respond in less than 2 hours during business hours. If you write outside hours, you'll have it by next morning.
contactPage.faq3a: 1) We listen. 2) We analyze. 3) In 48h we present a concrete proposal with prices and timelines. You decide.

contactPage.faq4a: No. We work by project or monthly fee with no contract. You can cancel whenever you want.
